summary: Tested subscription state propagation bug fix. Backend API tests (11/11 PASS) confirm subscription creation and feature access work correctly. Frontend E2E test confirms premium users can access Fridge Scanner without Feature Locked modal when subscription state is properly refreshed via trigger-subscription-refresh event. The fix centralizes subscription state in FeatureGate.jsx with version-based updates.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscription bug fix is verified working. Key flow: 1) User registers (FREE plan), 2) Create subscription via API, 3) Dispatch trigger-subscription-refresh event, 4) Navigate to /fridge-scanner - no Feature Locked modal should appear for premium users. The SubscriptionProvider in FeatureGate.jsx listens for the refresh event and re-fetches subscription state.

bug_fix_confirmed.original_issue: Paying users (Chef Pro Annual) seeing Feature Locked modal despite having paid subscription
bug_fix_confirmed.root_cause: Scattered subscription refresh calls not properly updating centralized state
bug_fix_confirmed.fix_implemented: Centralized SubscriptionProvider with version-based update mechanism via trigger-subscription-refresh event
